description: A Maven project named 'sort-algorithms' has been loaded in IntelliJ IDEA at ~/IdeaProjects/sort-algorithms/. The project contains InsertionSort and SelectionSort implementations with passing tests, but it has never been put under version control — there is no .git directory. Your task is to: (1) Initialize a Git repository for this project using IntelliJ's VCS integration. (2) Create a .gitignore file that excludes build artifacts (target/ directory), IDE files (.idea/ directory, *.iml files), and compiled class files (*.class). (3) Stage and commit all source files with the message 'Initial commit'. (4) Create a new branch named 'feature/add-merge-sort'. (5) On that branch, add a new file MergeSort.java in src/main/java/com/sorts/ that implements a working merge sort algorithm. (6) Add a corresponding test class MergeSortTest.java in src/test/java/com/sorts/ with at least 3 test methods. (7) Commit these new files on the feature branch with a meaningful commit message.
